notes: Single run, no prior attempts. Translated the authors' 'Consumption_Experiment tables and values.do' Table 2 and Table 3 regressions to R using the precomputed variables in Consumption_Experiment.csv (avg_id_stage2, id_stage2, qe_ard_lower/qe_ard/qe_ard_upper, pap_sample, dispersed, treatment, pizza, main, control). OLS on a constant / condition indicator via fixest::feols with vcov='hetero'; Tobit via AER::tobit with left=-63, right=63 (Stata ll(-63) ul(63)). Rows with missing outcome dropped as Stata does; Stata's `x == 1` treated as false for missing x. Donation-Treatment level is the constant of qe_ard ~ control, and the reported difference is minus the control coefficient, per the do-file comment. N = 100 (Table 2) and 200 (all Table 3 columns).
